title.narrative: Parliamentary Committee on Energy field visit

description.narrative: Field visit for parliamentary committee on energy for them to see rural electrificatio based on small Power Project based on renewables
Fältbesök för parlamentets energiutskott för dem att se mindre energilösningar på landsbygden, baserade på förnybar energi

The objectives of this intervention was to get members of the Parliamentary Committee on Energy and Minerals to visit some of the off-grid electrification projects, which Sweden supports, in order for them to better understand the purpose and benefits of off-grid electrification so that their parliamentary work in the energy sector is better informed.

sector.narrative: Energy sector policy, planning and administration

description.narrative:
The site visits resulted in a better understanding among parliamentarians about offgrid electrification. Several members, in a follow-up meeting, expressed that it was likely that their policy guidence and parliamentary work would have been different if they had undertaken the site visit earlier. Meaning that they have gotten a better understanding and appreciation about offgrid electrification and now see it as a viable alternative in remote, rural areas to grid expansion.
The Chairman of the Parliamentary Committee on Energy and Minerals expressed a willingness to do another site visit, now together with the Minister of Energy in order for the Minister too, to better understand how offgrid electrification can support the development of Tanzania.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
